# Selection for improved flight performance

## Fecundity

See Methods section for details of experimental set-up.

### Call relevant packages

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)
library(cowplot)
library(AICcmodavg)
library(lmerTest)
library(nlme)

theme_set(theme_cowplot())
```

### Import and wrangle data

Imported into a tibble "Fecund_data_raw" and processed into "Fecund_data"

```{r}
Fecund_data_raw <- read_excel("FF_Fecundity.xlsx")

Fecund_data <- Fecund_data_raw %>% 
  mutate(TotF = PopFemales + Crush_or_Esc_F + Dead_F,
         TotPop = 
           PopMales + PopFemales + 
           Crush_or_Esc_M + Crush_or_Esc_F +
           Crush_or_Esc_U + Dead_M + Dead_F) %>% 
  mutate(PopRep = paste(Selection, Replicate, sep = "_")) %>% 
  mutate(PlateNest = paste(PopRep, Plate, sep = "_")) %>% 
  mutate(Ind_Fec = Fecundity/TotF) %>% 
  mutate_at(c("Selection", "Replicate", "PopRep", "PlateNest"),
            factor)

Mean_fec <- Fecund_data %>% group_by(Selection, PopRep) %>% summarise(M_Fec = mean(Ind_Fec))


```

### Analysis

Fit full model (with 3 replicates per treatment combination)

NOTE: lmer can't fit model with plates nested within population replicates, because there is no replication within plate readings.

```{r}
fit_Fec_1 <- lmer(data = Fecund_data, REML = T,
  Ind_Fec ~ Selection + (1|PopRep))

anova(fit_Fec_1)
```

Fit mean fecundity (average across all three plates).

```{r}
fit_Fec_mean <- lme(data = Mean_fec, method = "REML",
                     M_Fec ~ Selection, random = ~1|PopRep)

anova(fit_Fec_mean)
```

## Plots

```{r}
ggplot(data = Fecund_data, aes(x = Selection, y = Ind_Fec)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) + 
  geom_point(aes(shape = Replicate), 
             position = position_jitter(width = 0.1), 
             size = 1.5, color = "steelblue") + 
 stat_summary(fun = "mean", color = "red", shape = "-", size = 4) 
```
